### Professional Summary

Highly skilled in C#, .NET platforms, SQL data integrity validation, and Python scripting, backed by proven success guiding QA teams through enterprise cloud migrations and complex hardware-interfacing software solutions. A collaborative technical leader adept at conducting code reviews, implementing Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and driving testing best practices to guarantee dependable system performance in real-time operations.
